name: FRIDAY
author: Project FRIDAY
description: Live FRIDAY cognitive status in a native Omarchy bar widget: daemon status, current activity, last goal outcome, voice, and host telemetry — rendered from the genuine file-backed state (R5-1-2). Passive observe-only surface; no command entry (that joins in R5-1-3).

barWidget.description: A calm, peripheral FRIDAY status widget: glanceable bar dot + rich panel reflecting the daemon's state.json read model. It observes and reflects genuine state only; it issues no commands yet (R5-1-3).

schema.label: Path to state.json (empty = default ~/.local/state/friday/state.json)
schema.description: Override the daemon state file this widget watches.
